heuristicSignals: Strong support requires high alignment, non-low confidence, and substantial evidence quality unless directly confirmed.
Independent supported families omitted at the slot limit are coverage candidates, not automatic defects.
Canonical/alias duplication is more concerning than intentional directional or family overlap.

rubric.limitations: These deterministic heuristics audit internal consistency. They are not validated measures of identity accuracy, user satisfaction, or population frequency.

directInterest.policyA: Existing runtime: direct-interest roles remain excluded from automatic recommendations and available through manual exploration.
directInterest.policyB: Not simulated quantitatively. The repository has no reviewed contract mapping explicit responses to one exact direct-interest role, so enabling candidates would invent eligibility rules.
directInterest.requiredDecision: Define the exact user action, evidence storage, per-role mapping, confidence semantics, safeguards, and whether confirmed labels may become primary.
